news.title: Philippines women’s national football team secures qualification for 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup
news.lede: News On AIR | March 19, 2026 1:13 PM. The Philippines women’s national football team have secured qualification for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup after defeating the Uzbekistan women’s national football team 2-0 in a Women’s Asian Cup play-in match on the Gold Coast today. Angela Beard delivered a standout performance, opening the scoring early in the second half after earlier missed opportunities. She found the net in the 47th minute with a well-taken strike into the roof of the goal.

news.title: Nigerian Football Crisis: A House of Failure
news.lede: NIGERIAN football faces a sombre moment. For a country once regarded as a continental power, it should not be. The corrosive gloom deepened between July and August after the Super Falcons’ landmark failure to qualify for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup Finals in Brazil. Nigeria’s pride as the African women’s football lodestar was extinguished at the Women’s African Cup of Nations in August when the 10-time African champions were unceremoniously disgraced in the quarterfinals by Cameroon.

news.title: Ranking the 10 best midfielders in world football: Rodri, Rice, Vitinha…
news.lede: Who reigns supreme among world football’s central midfielders? The competition has rarely been fiercer, after superstar names from Barcelona, Manchester City and PSG strengthened their case at the 2026 World Cup. To be crystal clear, this list is reserved for proper midfielders, i.e. No.6s and No.8s – players you’d happily trust in a midfield two.

news.title: The 10 best left-backs in world football RANKED: Mendes, Cucurella...
news.lede: Left-backs at Arsenal, PSG, Real Madrid, Inter, Manchester City and Bayern Munich can all be considered to be among the standouts in their position across world football right now. Whether it’s locking down elite wingers, inverting into midfield or providing width in attack, these are the players doing it better than anyone else. Here’s our ranking of the 10 best left-backs in world football at this moment in time. Probably not even the best left/centre-back hybrid at his club, which is more of a statement of the scary defensive depth that Mikel Arteta’s Arsenal are blessed with.

news.title: Kylian Mbappe labelled 'childish and pathetic' by France World Cup winner over Ballon d'Or claim
news.lede: Real Madrid star Mbappe thinks this 'might be a good year' for him to win the award for the first time. Talking up his chances ahead of Madrid's Champions League opener against Inter Milan, the France captain – who broke the all-time World Cup goals record this summer – said: "I think when you play for Real Madrid, the best club in the world, people associate you with this award [the Ballon d'Or]. "There are many people that speak about me and the Ballon d'Or. Of course I've made history in the most important competition.

news.title: Ronaldinho to make football comeback aged 46
news.lede: More than a decade after his last professional appearance, Brazilian superstar Ronaldinho is set for a comeback. The former world player of the year is to play in Italy’s third tier. While Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are still playing at 39 and 41 respectively, most football fans thought Ronaldinho belonged to another footballing era. That all changed in June, when Italian Serie C club, Ravenna, announced that the former Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain and AC Milan forward would play for them in the upcoming season.

news.title: ‘USA Gotta Wake Up’ — Team USA Fans Concerned After France’s Historic Win at FIBA World Cup
news.lede: France’s 111-56 blowout win over Nigeria to finish off their group play was a statement victory, with Gabby Williams leading the charge on the offensive end of the floor. Comparing France’s continued dominance to how much Team USA struggled against Italy last night, Team USA fans expressed worry about their chances going forward. France broke the record for the most threes made in a women’s World Cup game, hitting 22 three-pointers. Williams, who led France in scoring with 25 points, also set an individual record, becoming the first French player to hit 6 three-pointers at a World Cup game.
